title: Packaging you can actually open — Image Wiki

rules.rule: Opening force must not exceed 3 lb (1.36 kg) for one-handed operation without pinching, twisting, or grasping; boxes over 5 lb require two hands.
rules.evidence: The pack must open with one hand, and without the ability to pinch, to twist the wrist, or to grasp with the hand — three separate abilities, tested separately. Boxes over 5 lb must allow two hands.

rules.rule: Barcode quiet zones must be clear; for EAN-13, the left quiet zone must be at least 11X and the right at least 7X where X is the narrowest bar width.
rules.evidence: including the blank quiet zones, which for EAN-13 must be at least 11X on the left and 7X on the right.

rules.rule: Braille dot diameter must be 1.5 mm with 2.4 mm centre-to-centre spacing, kept 8 mm clear of any edge or crease, regardless of package size.
rules.evidence: dot diameter 1.5 mm, dot spacing 2.4 mm centre to centre, character pitch 6 mm, kept 8 mm clear of any edge or crease
